scenes.speaker: Team Locker Room
lines: Your football team just clinched the inter-college tournament trophy!
In the parking lot, the team captain opens the boot with smuggled drinks: "Champs celebrate hard! Drink up or you're off the first team!"

choices.text: "I play for the game and my fitness. Respect the game, captain — I'm good with fresh juice."
choices.feedback: Athletic integrity! True sportsmen respect their bodies more than peer approval.

choices.text: "My family is waiting at the main gate for dinner, catch you guys at practice Monday!"
choices.feedback: Graceful exit that celebrates the win without compromising personal discipline.

scenes.speaker: Coach's Praise
lines: On Monday, Coach recognizes your discipline and consistency during fitness trials.
Your future as an athlete stays on track.
